name: Hyderabad at Dawn
tagline: Wake up with Hyderabad. Stay for breakfast.
intro: Experience Hyderabad before the city wakes up. An intimate early-morning journey through its streets, markets and everyday rituals, ending with an iconic local breakfast.

name: Welcome Hyderabad
intro: A warm introduction to Hyderabad around a beautifully curated Telugu table. Meet fellow visitors and newcomers, discover the city through food and conversation, and leave knowing what to explore next.

name: Hyderabad After Dark
tagline: See where Hyderabad goes after hours.
intro: A hosted evening through contemporary Hyderabad: good food, interesting places, music, conversations and the city’s changing social scene.

name: The Hyderabad Table
intro: A signature Asli Hyderabad dining experience hosted at exceptional restaurants, heritage settings and interesting spaces across the city. Every edition brings together a place, a menu, a story and interesting people around one table. One edition could explore Deccani cuisine, another contemporary Telugu food, another the city’s Nizam heritage, and another Hyderabad through the eyes of a chef, artist, entrepreneur or cultural voice.
where: Venue, theme and date announced for each edition

name: Ramzan Nights
tagline: Haleem, lights, and an Old City awake till dawn.
intro: For one month the Old City keeps different hours. Walk Charminar’s night bazaar with a host who knows which haleem is worth the queue, taste the season’s specials, and see the lanes of Laad Bazaar lit up after iftar.
experience: The lanes of Laad Bazaar after iftar
draft: Details expanded from the homepage copy

name: Festival Hyderabad
tagline: Join the city when it celebrates.
intro: Bonalu fills the Old City with processions and drums; Bathukamma fills the lakes with flowers. Join the city on its own festival days, with a host who can take you close, explain what you are seeing and bring you to the table afterwards.
experience: Bonalu processions in the Old City
where: Set by the festival calendar each year
